key_derivation: The score is read from exactly one XPath, which pins the complete set. cake.cs:515 is `XmlPeek(target, "/Project/PropertyGroup/MutationScore/text()")`, and `grep -rn "<MutationScore>" --include=*.csproj` returns exactly five hits, all 100: Polly.csproj:8, Polly.Core.csproj:10, Polly.Extensions.csproj:9, Polly.RateLimiting.csproj:9, Polly.Testing.csproj:10. cake.cs:556 passes it to Stryker as `--break-at` with `--config-file eng/stryker-config.json`, whose thresholds high/low are both 100 (eng/stryker-config.json:27-30) and whose test-runner is 'mtp' / target-framework net10.0 (lines 25-26); th
